operators.name: split
semantics: Performs torch.split(x, split_size, axis) exactly, preserving input strides and views.
The number of output tensors is ceil(dim_size / split_size).
Each output tensor shares storage with input when possible (view semantics).
The tuple order follows increasing offset along the split axis.

operators.name: sum
semantics: Performs torch.sum(x) over all elements, returning a 0-dim tensor.
Reduction is done in float32 on CUDA.
Order of summation may follow efficient CUDA reduction but must produce equivalent result within tolerance.
Splits input tensor of shape [512, 3, 384, 64] along axis=2 with split_size=2, yielding 192 tensors of shape [512, 3, 2, 64].
Each resulting tensor is a view with stride [73728, 24576, 64, 1].
The result is a tuple of these tensors.
For each split tensor t, computes torch.sum(t), a scalar (0-dim) tensor.
Result is a Python list of 192 scalar tensors, each on cuda:0.
Returns the list of scalar sums.
